title: Auto Hold operation and persistence
summary: Feedback about Auto Hold centers on one request for the setting to stay enabled between drives, one report of inconsistent operation, and several service interactions explaining how the feature works.

positive.summary: The positive feedback asks for Auto Hold to remain on across trips as a usability improvement.

negative.summary: The negative feedback reports Auto Hold as broken or inconsistent in operation.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined excerpts mainly document writers asking whether Auto Hold was enabled or explaining that it holds the brakes at a stop until acceleration disengages it.

limitations: Most excerpts are undetermined service-writer explanations rather than clear customer evaluations.
The sample is small, and the positive evidence is a feature request rather than straightforward praise.
One undetermined fragment notes customer satisfaction after clarification, but it is not assigned a positive sentiment and cannot be used as positive evidence.
